judgement.reason: Coolify is a self-hosted PaaS that manages servers and containers over SSH, and it runs Reverb WebSockets, a terminal server, Horizon and a scheduler together; Deployz cannot provide that set of services in a single-port stateless container.

evidence.quote: It helps you manage servers, applications, and databases on your own hardware. You only need an SSH connection.
